summary: Make the Usage pane's OpenTelemetry link meet AA contrast in dark and light themes, and give each pane its own landmark names (`label`, default 'Usage', and `${label}: objectives/budgets/accounts`). Usage stories pass `Usage · <read>` per specimen, and AllStates asserts each unique outer region plus the live and stale section regions.

replay.detail: Presentation and accessibility naming only; no production replay changes.

rules.detail: Fixes the measured color-contrast and duplicate landmark-name violations; adds no accessibility or scanner exemptions.

compatibility.detail: The workspace pane keeps its outer name 'Usage'; its section landmarks become 'Usage: objectives', 'Usage: budgets' and 'Usage: accounts', while visible headings are unchanged. The link mixes 80% brand blue with the theme ink (#5b87f2 dark, #1d46b5 light).

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes. Revert the link color and the `label` prop and section names in apps/fractal-web/src/monitor/UsagePane.tsx, revert the per-specimen label and the AllStates region assertions in UsagePane.stories.tsx, and remove this note.
